methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly for each vendor: supabase.com/pricing, firebase.google.com/pricing, appwrite.io/pricing, nhost.io/pricing, back4app.com/pricing/backend-as-a-service, convex.dev/pricing, xano.com/pricing, and pocketbase.io. Security/compliance pages were fetched for each (supabase.com/security, appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security, convex.dev/security, nhost.io/pricing); supplemental WebSearch corroborated Appwrite SOC 2 (Type I only), Firebase HIPAA-eligible services via the Google Cloud BAA, and Back4App HIPAA being Dedicated-plan-only. Xano publishes annual-billing prices only; Essential ($85/mo) and Pro ($224/mo) are the billed-annually monthly-equivalents (noted per plan). Convex Professional is per-developer ($25/dev/mo). PocketBase is open-source self-hosted software with no official commercial SaaS pricing; monthlyUsd is 0. Enterprise/Custom tiers with no published price have monthlyUsd=null. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from firebase.google.com/pricing (Spark $0; Blaze pay-as-you-go). HIPAA/BAA verified via Google Cloud compliance docs and WebSearch: Firebase uses the Google Cloud BAA; HIPAA-eligible services include Cloud Firestore, Firebase Auth, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Hosting, Realtime Database — Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring and several others are NOT covered.

plans.name: Spark (No-Cost)
plans.notes: Firestore: 1 GiB storage, 50K reads/day, 20K writes/day, 10 GiB/mo egress. Auth: 50K MAUs. Cloud Storage: 5 GB. Functions: 2M invocations/mo, 400K GB-seconds/mo. Hosting: 10 GB storage, 360 MB/day transfer. Realtime DB: 1 GB stored. No payment method required; cannot use paid services.

plans.name: Blaze (Pay as you go)
plans.notes: Includes all Spark free quotas then pay-as-you-go; no fixed monthly fee. Functions: $0.40/million invocations above 2M free. Cloud Storage: $0.026/GB storage, $0.12/GB downloads. Hosting: $0.026/GB storage, $0.15/GB transfer. Realtime DB: $5/GB stored, $1/GB downloaded. Firestore and Auth (beyond 50K MAUs) follow Google Cloud pricing. Eligible users receive $300 free credit.

limits: Spark: 50K Auth MAUs, 1 GiB Firestore, 5 GB Cloud Storage, 2M Functions invocations/mo

Built-in A/B testing, Remote Config, and Crashlytics
Blaze unlocks Cloud Functions and all GCP services; HIPAA only via Google Cloud BAA on eligible services
